body: Structured triage findings submitted for trusted action evaluation.

data.audit: Read examples/ignore_example_for_e2e/main.tf and README.md directly from checked-out default branch; confirmed tag present. Read PR #56 diff (adds the tag to both files). Inspected PR #149, #167, #274 diffs — none touch resource group tags. Read must_compare candidates #286, #287, #289, #290, #292, #293 — none duplicate this request.
data.findings:
Issue requests `tags = { test = "test" }` on the resource group in `examples/ignore_example_for_e2e/main.tf`, explicitly scoped to that RG only (not module tag propagation). Verified current default-branch source: `examples/ignore_example_for_e2e/main.tf` and its `README.md` already contain `tags = { test = "test" }` on `azapi_resource.this`. PR #56 ("Add tags to azapi_resource in main.tf", merged) added exactly this line to both files — matching the issue's own description. No later commit removes it.

Duplicate check: none of #286/#287 (retired closed fixture placeholders, no content) or #289/#290/#292/#293 (unrelated feature requests: role-assignment API version, shared interfaces utility, managed identity ID validation, role assignment names) describe this RG-tagging request — not duplicates, not closely related.

Other plausible PR-inventory hits: #149 (dependency version bumps only), #167 (version alignment + naming module changes for VNet name, unrelated to tags), #274 (bot pre-commit formatting + telemetry header cleanup, unrelated). None address tagging.

Conclusion: the requested change already exists in source via PR #56. Submitting for release-membership verification.
